music.note: passed to music.bed(): drop = the picture's climax (a bar line lands on it), outro = start of the end hold; pick bpm so a beat is a whole number of frames (112.5 at 30 fps = 16); "bed": null for clips that deliver only the effects stem

events.note: a picture event and its one sound, checked by sync.py; the picture reads the same t (the template's title pops in here)
example of a repeated hit: one sound per time, each checked; bus sfx = no ducking (dense small hits)

motion.note: whooshes, risers, swells, pen strokes: sounds without a sharp onset; played on the sfx bus without ducking, not checked by sync.py
